entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Ms. Sharmila Sharma, learned counsel for the appellant
 Shri K. K. Tiwari, learned Govt. Advocate for the respo
Heard on the question of admission.
Admit.

02.  Also, heard o n I.A. No.2690/2023, which is first application filed under Section 389 of Cr.P.C.
for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail moved on behalf of appellant - Kutubuddin.

03. Learned Trial Court has convicted the appellant under Sections 342, 376(2)(j), 376(20(k),
376AB & 377 of the IPC and Sections 5(k)0/6, 5(m)/6 and 5(n)/6 of the POCSO Act and sentenced to 1 years R.I. with fine of Rs.1,000/-, imprisonment for life with fine for Rs.10,000/-,
imprisonment for life with fine for Rs.10,000/-, imprisonment for life with fine for Rs.10,000/-,
imprisonment for life with fine for Rs.10,000/- respectively with default stipulation, vide its judgement of conviction and order of sentence dated 20.07.2022 passed by the learned Sessions Judge, Alirajpur in S. T. No.79/2021.
04.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant has falsely been implicated in the case as there was a previous enmity between the parties.
No any injury was found in the private part of the victim and no sperm was found on the cloths of the victim/appellant.
Also, nothing has been found in the DNA profiling.
The case is fully concocted.

This appeal is of year 2022 and final hearing of this appeal is not possible in near future, therefore, it is prayed that the substantial jail sentence of the appellant be suspended and he may be released on bail.
05. On the other hand, learned Govt. Advocate for the respondent/State opposed the prayer of the appellant and prayed for its rejection.
We have gone through the record and perused the judgment of the trial Court.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, evidence available on record that there is animosity between the parties and the medical evidence, coupled with the fact that the final conclusion of this appeal will take considerable time, at this stage we are inclined to suspend the remaining jail sentence of appellant, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, the application I.A. No.2690/2023 is allowed.
07.

It is directed that subject to deposit of fine amount, if not already deposited, and on furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court o n 23.09.2024 and on all other subsequent dates, as may be fixed by the Registry in this behalf, the execution of substantial jail sentence imposed on the appellant Kutubuddin shall remain suspended,
till final disposal of this appeal.
List this matter for final hearing in due course.
Certified copy as per rules.

(S. A. DHARMADHIKARI) (DEVN  JUDGE   VS Kutubuddin vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 14 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129710884/
